name: Virginia Stapleton

bio.statement: In her pamphlet statement, Stapleton lists her occupation as mom, community advocate and volunteer, with prior service as Salem City Councilor and Council President and on the Salem-Keizer School District Budget Committee.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: Mom, Community advocate, volunteer Prior Governmental Experience: Salem City Councilor, Council President; Salem-Keizer School District Budget Committee

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet 2026 General, Marion/Polk edition (Book 8), p. 42
